title: Acquire the actual interface while retaining the nonlinear and counting boundaries
statement: The second route independently rehashes Y at each dimension, tests bucket/bit presence using the same fingerprint point, and stops when occupied buckets fix all bits. Independent stage collision tails support expected-polynomial work; nested hashes were rejected. A conservative raw-DAG affine-interface pass supplies parity masks and rewrites the nonlinear consumer; graph-specific reconstruction returns checked original matchings. General nonlinear observations would cross SAT: independent four-cycle matching choices encode assignments and a one-bit SAT observation has<=2 outcomes. This is not a SAT solver. New original-input observations may require acquiring a larger JOINT model; complete marginals do not determine correlations. Feasible outcomes do not give probabilities: one fixed K6 edge has two outcomes but multiplicities12 and3, so probability1/5, not1/2.

requires: Raw simple matching graph and explicit binary edge-observation matrix; matching witness reconstruction uses the graph-specific checked decoder.

Alternatively a raw division-free characteristic-two arithmetic circuit and linear observations of monomial exponent parity AFTER algebraic cancellation; known degree/extension-field restrictions and actual evaluator costs.
Consumer reads original input through the acquired JOINT affine interface; conservative syntactic extraction supplies sufficient parity masks, not a minimal semantic interface.

assumptions: Completed released visible scientific response only, with ordered formula annotations and citations. No P3 original code, proof attachments or review files were acquired; no-upload/no-export/no-repackaging/no-alternate-transfer restrictions remain binding. Raw graph/circuit access and the JOINT specified linear parity interface are essential. Randomized complete-model confidence is distinct from deterministic verification of a supplied overflow certificate. Cost polynomial in the actual outcome count can be exponential in raw input; the complete feasible-outcome catalogue supplies neither probabilities nor multiplicities. Ordinary comparators won the small total-work tests. No external priority, independent scientific review or practical speed advantage is established.
costs: Dimension r equals the number of distinct attainable joint outcomes. Candidate/border count O(kr), candidate degree<=1+floor(log2 r), coefficient width<2r, and candidate identities have<=r+1 terms.

Conservative arithmetic work includes r^(2+log2 3), raw evaluation,k and confidence factors; straightforward binary elimination can cost O(k ell r^4). These are substantial polynomials; r may be exponential.

Fresh independent hashes at each dimension are required for the second expected-polynomial route; the rejected nested-hash plan lacks the necessary cost-tail guarantee. Hash arrays may be larger and rare stages expensive.

Producer K6/five-parity example with11 outcomes: basis49.5ms(54.4ms with witnesses), hash99.1ms(112.4ms), sparse propagation2.22ms and ordinary subset DP0.0485ms.150-query table reuse2.33ms excludes acquisition; demand-driven BDD teacher40.6ms total wins the total-work comparison.
